subject: System Design
title: What Is System Design?
description: A short lesson to help you apply What Is System Design?.

hook.text: You open Instagram. In 200 milliseconds, dozens of services collaborate to show your feed.

buildup.text: System design is the art of deciding how software components connect and work together.

discovery.text: It answers questions like: where does data live, how do parts communicate, what happens at scale?

twist.text: There's no single correct design. Every choice involves trade-offs between competing goals.

climax.text: Great system design isn't about perfection — it's about making the right trade-offs for your context.

punchline.text: Design is choosing which trade-offs you can live with.

quiz.question: What is system design fundamentally about?
options: How software components connect and work together
